about: Source of truth for the status of every game service table, capability and its evidence. tools/status_registry.py validates this file and renders the service table of docs/game/status.md from it (between the status-registry markers); edit this file, never the rendered table. Every value restates what the repository already documents (evidence_source names where); nothing here has been run in game. evidence_level: sigcheck_resolved = every row the capability reads is OK in a sco-sigcheck report of game_build, nothing executed; in_game_verified = run in a game session on a recorded date (no entry has it); off_pending_probe = rows resolve, an in-game probe must settle an open question first; synthetic_only = synthetic/native-boundary tests only; blocked = no trustworthy locator, nothing published; undocumented = the repository records no evidence. stability (schema_version 2, docs/stability.md): required on every service and event_bus entry, absent on signature_rows entries (not service tables). A new label is stable when at least one capability has evidence_level sigcheck_resolved, off_pending_probe or in_game_verified, otherwise experimental. stable_since (required with stable) names the SDK release that first carries the label; once that release is out the label stays stable for the rest of that SDK major, whatever later evidence says. It is a compatibility promise about the table, not availability or evidence.
